package service

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

type LessonGenerationInput struct {
	CourseContext map[string]any
	Lesson        domain.PlannedLesson
	Language      string
}

type GeneratedLessonContent struct {
	DescriptionMarkdown string                  `json:"description_markdown"`
	Examples            []domain.PlannedExample `json:"examples"`
	KnowledgeChecks     []domain.PlannedTask    `json:"knowledge_checks"`
}

type ContentGenerator interface {
	GenerateLesson(context.Context, LessonGenerationInput, string) (GeneratedLessonContent, error)
}
